spf.comment: Covers a narrow 1:0 home breakthrough built on Sapporo's home scoring consistency and a 1:1 draw triggered by confirmed absences for Nishino and Supachok, whereas Tosu's 62.5% away failed-to-score rate makes a single Home Win too narrow without justifying an outright away call.

score.comment: Reflects the top two Home Win / Draw outcomes in the 1.28 vs 1.09 Poisson matrix, matching Sapporo's recent 1:0 wins and the risk of conceding once from a Tosu set piece.

goals.comment: Aligns with the top two exact totals in the Poisson distribution (26.3% and 22.2%) and both teams' low first-half scoring rates.

bqc.comment: Grounded in Sagan Tosu's 75.0% away half-time draw rate and both teams' heavy second-half goal shares, branching between a late Sapporo winner and a 1:1 stalemate.
